zh:
- Windows 托盘菜单新增“停止当前响铃”，无需重新打开应用即可停止正在播放的闹钟。
- 三语同步更新 Windows 后台闹钟说明，明确窗口隐藏到托盘后仍可响铃。
- 保持系统字体选择、托盘截止摘要和后台闹钟能力。
en:
- Add Stop current alarm to the Windows tray menu so ringing can stop without reopening the app.
- Update the Windows alarm guidance in all three languages to explain that alarms continue while the window is hidden to the tray.
- Keep system font selection, tray deadline summaries and background alarms.
